name: Annapurna Base Camp
why: Through Gurung villages and bamboo forest into the Annapurna Sanctuary, a ring of glaciers and 7,000 m walls with Machhapuchhre straight above.
book: Annapurna Conservation Area permit and TIMS card. Since April 2023 Nepal requires foreign trekkers to hire a licensed guide in its national parks and conservation areas (check the current rule before you go). Jeep from Pokhara to Nayapul or Ghandruk. Book lodges ahead in October: the sanctuary lodges are few.
water: Teahouses all the way; drinking water stations at Chhomrong and Bamboo.
dangers: Avalanche risk between Deurali and Machhapuchhre Base Camp after heavy snow: ask at Chhomrong before going up.
Thousands of stone steps above Chhomrong: hard on the knees going down.
Leeches in the forest in spring and after rain.
turnaround: Do not cross the avalanche stretch above Deurali in fresh snow or after 13:00.

points.name: Ghandruk
points.note: A large Gurung village of stone roofs facing Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre.

points.name: Chhomrong
points.note: The last village, terraced on a steep slope; stone steps down to the river and up again.

points.name: Bamboo
points.note: Lodges in a bamboo and rhododendron forest deep in the Modi Khola gorge.

points.name: Machhapuchhre Base Camp
points.note: The gate of the sanctuary at 3,700 m under the fishtail peak.

points.name: Annapurna Base Camp
points.note: Lodges at 4,130 m on the moraine, surrounded by Annapurna I, Annapurna South and Hiunchuli.
